selected_light_jets.name: selected_light_jets
selected_light_jets.definition: [j for j in light_jets if j['pt'] > 30 and abs(j['eta']) < 2.5]

selected_bjets.name: selected_bjets
selected_bjets.definition: [b for b in bjets if b['pt'] > 30 and abs(b['eta']) < 2.5], selected_light_jets = [j for j in light_jets if j['pt'] > 30 and abs(j['eta']) < 2.5]

selected_leptons.name: selected_leptons
selected_leptons.definition: selected_electrons + selected_muons, selected_bjets = [b for b in bjets if b['pt'] > 30 and abs(b['eta']) < 2.5]
